Scaffold.title: Send a feeling, not just a gift.
Scaffold.subtitle: Scaffold is live. Phase 2 wires the full landing page; Phase 3 ships the recipient envelope; Phases 4–8 add the five gift builders.
Scaffold.footer: Made with care in Hong Kong · 為香港而設

hero.tag: Made in Hong Kong · 為香港而設
hero.lede: Lovorithm turns your photos, voice notes, and words into a one-of-a-kind digital gift — a memory card game, a love letter, a quiz only they'd know how to pass.

cards.title: Memory card game
cards.body: Pick photos. We turn them into a matching game. Every match unlocks a memory.

puzzle.title: Photo puzzle
puzzle.body: Drag tiles back into place. The picture they were missing is the point.

quiz.title: "How well do you know me?" quiz
quiz.body: Multiple-choice questions only they'd get right. Wrong answers are funny. Right answers are sweet.

collage.title: Multimedia collage
collage.body: Photos, short video, a song, your captions. Browsable, not just scrolled past.

letter.title: Animated letter
letter.body: A scroll-reveal letter that opens like a real envelope. Photos and voice notes drop in as you read.

1.title: Pick a format
1.body: Five gift types to choose from. Each one designed for a different kind of "I love you".

2.title: Add the personal bits
2.body: Photos, a voice note, your words. We help you arrange them so the moment hits right.

3.title: Send the link
3.body: One link, one QR code. Open it on their phone, they get the whole experience.

footer.line: Lovorithm · Made with care in Hong Kong

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: Lovorithm is built around gifts that often carry private moments — photos of people you love, voice notes, personal messages. We treat that material with care. This page explains what we collect, what we do with it, and what choices you have.

whatWeCollect.heading: What we collect
whatWeCollect.body: Account info (email, display name, handle, avatar) when you sign up. Gift content (photos, voice notes, text you write) when you create a gift. Recipients only see the gift you send them; we never expose your account details to them. Server logs (IP, user agent) for the usual operational reasons — rate limiting, abuse prevention, debugging.

howWeUse.heading: How we use it
howWeUse.body: To run the service: deliver gifts, send transactional email (purchase receipts, share links), prevent abuse. We do not sell or rent your data, and we do not run third-party advertising.

storage.heading: Where it is stored
storage.body: On Supabase (Singapore region). Photos and voice notes live in a private Supabase Storage bucket; only people with the share link can read them. Database backups are taken daily.

sharing.heading: Sharing
sharing.body: Gifts are shared via an opaque link. The link is unique per gift; please do not forward it to people you do not want to see the gift. We do not share your gift content with anyone outside the gift you explicitly created.

yourChoices.heading: Your choices
yourChoices.body: You can update or delete your account at any time from Settings. Deleting your account removes your profile and unpublished drafts. Gifts you have sent remain live for the recipient unless you ask us to take them down — email support@lovorithm.app and we will remove them within 7 days.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.body: We use one cookie to remember your language preference (en / zh-Hant), and the standard auth cookies Supabase sets for sign-in. No third-party tracking cookies.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Questions, concerns, or a deletion request? Email support@lovorithm.app.

Terms.title: Terms of service
Terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Lovorithm. Plain-language summary at the top of each section, the enforceable rule underneath.

theService.heading: The service
theService.body: Lovorithm is a marketplace for digital gifts. Creators list gifts; buyers claim them or send them to a recipient. We operate the platform, the payment rails, and the share-link delivery; the gift content itself belongs to the creator who authored it.

accounts.heading: Accounts
accounts.body: You need an account to buy or sell. Keep your credentials to yourself; you are responsible for activity under your account. We may suspend accounts that abuse the platform (spam, fraud, harassment).

yourContent.heading: Your content
yourContent.body: You retain ownership of the gifts you create. By publishing a listing, you grant Lovorithm a non-exclusive licence to host and deliver that gift to the buyer or recipient. You can unpublish a listing at any time; gifts already delivered remain live for the recipient unless you ask us to take them down.

purchases.heading: Purchases & refunds
purchases.body: Prices are listed in HKD or USD. Payment is processed by Stripe; we never see your card number. If a gift fails to deliver (broken share link, removed by the creator), email billing@lovorithm.app within 14 days for a full refund.

availability.heading: Availability
availability.body: We aim for 99.9% uptime but do not guarantee uninterrupted access. We will post incidents at /status and email subscribers when there is a material outage.

liability.heading: Liability
liability.body: To the maximum extent permitted by Hong Kong law, our liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim. We are not liable for indirect or consequential damages.

changes.heading: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms. Material changes get a 30-day notice via email and a banner in the app. Continued use after the effective date means you accept the new terms.

governing.heading: Governing law
governing.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Hong Kong. Disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Hong Kong.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms? Email legal@lovorithm.app.
